audience.text: Developers building .NET services, desktop tools, or CLI utilities that need to read, create, or inspect Outlook MSG, CFB, and EML data without requiring Microsoft Outlook or external dependencies.

capabilities.text: Use MapiMessage, MsgReader, MsgWriter, and MsgDocument to load, inspect, modify, and save Outlook MSG files at high and low levels.
capabilities.title: Read and write MSG files

capabilities.text: Parse and build Compound File Binary containers with CfbReader, CfbWriter, CfbDocument, CfbStorage, and CfbStream APIs.
capabilities.title: Process CFB containers

capabilities.text: Natively convert EML (RFC 5322/MIME) to MSG and back using MapiMessage.LoadFromEml() and SaveToEml() methods.
capabilities.title: Convert between MSG and EML

capabilities.text: Add recipients and attachments—including embedded messages—to MapiMessage objects using AddRecipient() and AddAttachment().
capabilities.title: Attach recipients and files

capabilities.text: Set and read arbitrary MAPI properties via SetProperty() and GetPropertyValue() beyond strongly-typed MapiMessage members.
capabilities.title: Inspect MAPI properties

capabilities.text: Access a read-only ValidationIssues list on MapiMessage and MsgDocument to detect structural anomalies during parsing.
capabilities.title: Validate parsing issues

limitations.text: No IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 support; the library only processes local files and streams.
No dedicated calendar or appointment API; calendar properties are accessible only generically.
Requires .NET 8.0 or later; classic .NET Framework is not supported.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic parsing and generation of Outlook MSG files and CFB containers without external dependencies or Microsoft Outlook installation.
Provides native EML/MIME parsing and MSG conversion without requiring external MIME libraries.
Supports forensic inspection and repair of MSG files through low-level CFB and MSG document APIs.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET 8.0 library for deterministic processing of Outlook MSG files, CFB containers, and EML messages, with no third-party dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact scope of 'forensic inspection' capabilities beyond what is documented is unclear.
Whether nested CFB structures beyond standard MSG containers are fully supported is not explicitly stated.
The behavior of strict parsing mode in MsgReader and MapiMessage is not detailed beyond ValidationIssues.
Support for non-Unicode string encodings in MSG files is not specified.
The library's handling of malformed or partially corrupted MSG files is not described beyond validation issues.
Whether custom MAPI property sets beyond standard ones are fully supported is not clarified.
The stability and versioning policy for the public API surface is not detailed beyond the 29 documented types.
Whether the library supports multi-targeting beyond net8.0 is not confirmed.

workflows.name: Create and save an MSG message
workflows.text: Use MapiMessage.Create() to build a message in memory, set properties like SenderName and AddRecipient(), attach streams, and save to disk with Save().

workflows.name: Read MSG file metadata
workflows.text: Load an MSG file with MapiMessage.FromFile() or MsgReader.FromFile() to inspect subject, body, recipients, and attachments, and access validation issues.

workflows.name: Inspect CFB container structure
workflows.text: Use CfbReader.FromFile() or CfbReader.FromStream() to traverse directory entries, list storages and streams, and resolve paths within a CFB container.

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Parse an RFC 5322/MIME .eml file into a MapiMessage using MapiMessage.LoadFromEml() and persist it as MSG with Save().
